messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: runtime v2.1.0 -> router-config v3.4.2 -> console patch 1.8.3. Canary at 5% for 20m. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Deploy ID: D-2026-03-05-77. Please ACK if you are on watch.
maya: ACK. I'll watch runtime metrics and latencies.
sam: ACK — I'll keep an eye on router error spikes and routing latencies.
elena: ACK. Console patch has a schema fix for session telemetry; validated locally.
ryan: Quick Q: do we need to pin api gateway to the new runtime ABI?
jesse: yes — api-gateway will pin to runtime:v2.1.0 for the rollout. If we see regressions we can switch to runtime:v2.0.7 (compat shim present).
ranjit: noted. If we need rollback, what's the exact rollback sequence? Can we do partial rollback (router only) to mitigate?
sam: We can rollback router-config alone to 3.4.1 to stop the new routing rules; runtime & console unaffected. That should buy time while we diagnose.
maya: Rollback commands for quick reference:
```
# router rollback
kubectl set image deploy/router router=image-registry/redwood/router:3.4.1 -n prod
# runtime rollback (if needed)
kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=image-registry/redwood/runtime:2.0.7 -n prod
# console rollback
kubectl set image deploy/console console=image-registry/redwood/console:1.8.2 -n prod
```
ryan: thanks — I'll keep those handy.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot: CPU avg +3%, p95 latency +12ms, error-rate unchanged at 0.03%. No rate limit spikes.
maya: p95 +12ms still within SLA cushion, but keep an eye on tokenization micro-regressions — we saw similar delta in e2e earlier.
jesse: If p95 creeps >20ms or error-rate >0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m windows, my plan is to pin router back and scale runtime pool by +10% to reduce tail latencies.
ranjit: agreed. Also flagging we should disable the new KV eviction rule in runtime if we see cache miss storm. That's a hot path for tail.
elena: console patch 1.8.3 rolled into 10% of users in canary. No JS errors on Sentry so far.
sam: small nit — the rollout notes in the release doc don't mention the runtime kernel selector fallback. Can someone add a short line?
maya: added note in the release doc (link: https://internal.redwood/release/D-2026-03-05-77).
deploy-bot: Deploy checkpoint: 10m elapsed, canary stable. Proceeding to 25% at +10m unless objections.
ryan: no objections.
jesse: thumbs up. Preparing an immediate rollback task if metrics cross thresholds.
ranjit: oncall aware and ready. ping me if cache miss rate > 0.6.
elena: tagging support for console rollback runbook in case we need it.
sam: one more: can we enable verbose runtime traces for 1% of requests to get richer KV/cache telemetry? Low overhead.
maya: good idea — I'll enable trace sampling=0.01 on runtime canary.
deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 25% at 1775502520. Next check-in at +15m.
maya: seeing steady metrics; p95 holding.
jesse: preparing PR to keep pin config for 24h post rollout, then we'll revert pin to allow autoswitch.
ranjit: if anything looks off, I'll trigger router rollback first. Otherwise we'll do full rollback.
ryan: thanks everyone. I'll update the incident channel if we need to escalate.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: reached 100% at 1775502580. Post-deploy checks: all green. If you notice anomalies, please call out here and follow rollback runbook. :rocket:
